s.note: the big game against the Cowboys
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 4 tbsp honey with 125ml barbecue sauce and toss the wings through. Mix sour cream with mayonnaise and herbs for a ranch dip, and serve with celery sticks.

Shape 500g beef mince into 8 small patties and season. Fry for 2 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheddar to each at the end. Fill 8 slider buns with the patties, pickles and mustard, then stick a little paper flag on a toothpick into each.

m.note: the family home in small-town Ohio
m.how: Brown a 1.5kg piece of beef chuck all over. Add a sliced onion, 3 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 500ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours, adding 800g halved potatoes for the last hour. Slice and serve with the vegetables and juices.

w.note: the football the whole town is mad about
w.how: Cream 125g butter with 150g brown sugar, beat in an egg, then mix in 250g flour and 40g cocoa. Shape into small footballs and flatten slightly. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Pipe white icing laces across the top with icing sugar and a little water.

d.note: the water boys on the sideline
d.how: Mix 500ml orange juice with the juice of 2 lemons and a small pinch of salt in a big jug. Top up with 1L cold water and plenty of ice. Stir well and pour into paper cups for the players coming off the field at halftime.
